purpose_context: Agent prompt changes reach office2 via a timer that git-pulls a shared checkout, but a second deploy actor (felix-deployer) races the shared FETCH_HEAD and intermittently breaks the pull for weeks, so merged prompt changes never reach the running Felix agents. This mission makes both actors' pulls race-immune, serializes their working-tree mutation, deletes the stale lane branch that amplifies the race, and adds a behind-N-ticks health signal so a silent deploy stall cannot recur.
purpose_tldr: Stop the office2 prompt-sync deploy path from silently failing under a git concurrency race.
